program.name: ENS Service Provider Program, Season 2 (SPP2)
program.authority: ENS DAO funded service-provider relationship with public quarterly delivery reporting

governingPolicy.version: SPP2 funded-provider quarterly reporting practice as evidenced by public reports category and EP6.13 stream terms

rules.description: EP6.13 lists Unruggable among funded SPP2 providers; the Q4 report is published in the Service Provider Program reports category.

eligibility.rationale: Delivery reporting presupposes the funded SPP2 relationship documented in EP6.13. Exact original eligibility-check timestamp is not re-established here.

evaluators.displayName: ENS DAO / public SPP reporting audience
evaluators.role: receive and review published quarterly provider reports

evidence.description: Unruggable SPP2 Q4 2025 quarterly report describing interoperability and AI-agent identity research delivery.
SPP2 selection proposal providing program context for Unruggable's funded role.
EP6.13 listing Unruggable at $400,000 one-year allocation.
Public SPP reports category for provider quarterly updates.

criteria.name: Published quarterly delivery narrative against funded SPP2 scope
criteria.scoreScale: qualitative public self-report; no independent numeric score published in reviewed sources

materialFindings.statement: The Q4 2025 report states Unruggable worked with Wonderland and the Ethereum Foundation on ERC-7930 and ERC-7828 and shipped related on.eth / ENSIP-24 chain-registry work.

The Q4 2025 report states Unruggable contributed to ERC-8004 Trustless Agents and related ENS AI-agent identity standards work as funded research/delivery, not as historical AI assistance in evaluating SPP applicants.

evaluation.aggregateScale: No published independent delivery score for this quarter in the reviewed sources.

decision.authority: Continuing SPP2 funded relationship evidenced by EP6.13 allocation and public Q4 delivery report; no new award decision is claimed for Q4
decision.rationale: This case reconstructs post-award delivery reporting for an already-funded SPP2 provider. The $400,000 figure is the EP6.13 annual allocation, not a new Q4 award. authorityKind remains dao-vote because the funding relationship originates in the DAO selection/implementation votes; no new Q4 award vote is claimed. No stream-pause or termination is invented.

challenge.scope: Reviewed public report artifacts do not identify a formal challenge process against the Q4 self-report.

deliveryConditions.description: Publish a Q4 2025 quarterly delivery update describing progress on funded interoperability and related work.
deliveryConditions.reviewWindow: Q4 2025 reporting window as evidenced by the published report thread
deliveryConditions.verificationMethod: Public forum quarterly report; not independent audit of every claimed deliverable.
deliveryConditions.verifier: ENS DAO / public SPP reporting audience
dependencies: Prior EP6.13 funded stream for Unruggable
deliveryConditions.consequence: This reconstruction records publication of the report; it does not invent stream-pause consequences for unmet milestones.

notes: Unit of analysis is post-award delivery reporting, not the original selection vote.
AI-agent identity research in the report is funded work product, not evidence of AI-assisted applicant evaluation.
Provider self-report is not converted into independent verification of every claimed deliverable.
decision.decidedAt for the original award is not re-litigated here and remains null.
